The '''2001–02 [[Super League Greece|Alpha Ethniki]]''' was the 66th season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece. The season began on 22 September 2001 and ended on 8 May 2002. [[Olympiacos F.C.|Olympiacos]] won their sixth consecutive and 31st Greek title.
